# nlohmann/json

This directory vendors the standalone header from the official nlohmann/json
`v3.12.0` release. It is kept in the source tree so clean builds are offline
and reproducible.

- Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
- Release asset: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.12.0/json.hpp
- `json.hpp` SHA-256: `AAF127C04CB31C406E5B04A63F1AE89369FCCDE6D8FA7CDDA1ED4F32DFC5DE63`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE.MIT`)

Do not update the header without updating `dependency-lock.json`, this file,
and the recorded hash check.
